2.69.21
Table.PageBreakAtStart
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The Table.PageBreakAtStart element specifies that the renderer adds a page break at the start of
this Table. This element is optional. The value of Table.PageBreakAtStart MUST be a Boolean
([XMLSCHEMA2/2] section 3.2.2). If this element is not specified, its value is interpreted as false.
Following is the parent element of the Table.PageBreakAtStart element.
Parent elements
Table
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Table.PageBreakAtStart element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreakAtStart" type="xsd:boolean" minOccurs="0" />
